about_the_game:
The Midnight Town Series: Adam's Afterlife

The final chapter of Adam’s story begins in a village he has never seen before—strange, quiet, and filled with shadows. Trapped in the Afterlife, Adam must navigate this unfamiliar world, where every corner hides danger and nothing is as it seems.

As the continuation of The Midnight Town: Adam’s Forgotten Secrets, this chapter challenges Adam to confront both the unknown and the remnants of his past. He will encounter villagers—some helpful, others mysterious—and must carefully decide who to trust. To survive, he must hide from relentless enemies, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the secrets that could finally set him free.

Every step tests his courage, wits, and will to survive. Will Adam escape the Afterlife and bring closure to his journey, or will he remain trapped forever? Adam’s Afterlife delivers a suspenseful, heart-pounding conclusion to the series, keeping players on edge until the very last moment.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Lower specs may work

  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600

  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
